proposedMilestone.goal: Ship hr-leave-payroll-platform epic (KAN-1) end-to-end through the SDLC pipeline

cards.title: [Epic] HR Employee Management, Leave & Payroll Platform
cards.body:
## Problem Statement
HR Admin (sole super-admin) needs to manage employee records (details, monthly payroll rate, supervisor assignment â€” supervisor is itself an employee) and run a leave workflow where an employee's leave routes to their supervisor, and a supervisor's own leave routes to HR Admin. Registration is manual by HR Admin; on success the system emails a generated password to the employee's personal (non-company) email, login via Authentik (email+password only). Leave types are fixed (annual, sick, unpaid) with per-employee balance tracking; leave beyond entitlement auto-converts to unpaid. Payroll auto-generates monthly via cron: monthly rate minus unpaid-leave deduction, rendered as a simple PDF stored in MinIO. Every logged-in user sees an in-app notification icon for: new leave request (supervisor), leave decision (employee), payroll generated (employee).

## Business Value
Proof-of-concept feature run end-to-end through the SDLC agent pipeline, to validate the agents can manage a project autonomously with minimal human supervision. Not a compliance-driven business requirement â€” bias toward simplicity throughout.

## Scope
- Employee registration & profile (incl. payroll rate, supervisor link)
- Authentik-based login (email + generated password)
- Leave request/approval workflow with fixed leave types + balance tracking
- Monthly automated payroll generation (PDF to MinIO)
- In-app notifications

## Out of Scope
- Payroll disbursement / bank integration
- Attendance / timesheet tracking
- Performance reviews
- Configurable leave types
- Extra regulatory/encryption controls beyond repo defaults
- Roles beyond HR Admin / Supervisor / Employee
- Email/push notifications (in-app only for v1)

## Acceptance Criteria
- HR Admin can CRUD employee records with payroll rate + supervisor
- New employee receives generated-password email, can log in via Authentik
- Employee submits leave; supervisor approves/rejects; supervisor's own leave goes to HR Admin
- Leave balances tracked per type; over-entitlement auto-converts to unpaid
- Payroll auto-generated monthly per employee, PDF stored in MinIO, reflects unpaid-leave deductions
- All users see in-app notifications for the three defined events

## Dependencies
All net-new â€” no existing servers to extend. New servers required: employee, leave, payroll (exact split decided at architecture/planning stage).

cards.title: [Story] Employee Registration & Profile Management
cards.body:
## User Story
As HR Admin, I want to register an employee's details, monthly payroll rate, and supervisor, so that the employee exists in the system with correct reporting hierarchy and can be paid and take leave.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given valid employee details + selected supervisor, when HR Admin submits registration, then an employee record is created, an Authentik account is provisioned, and a one-time success dialog shows HR Admin the employee's personal email + generated password (mocked credential delivery for v0.1.0 â€” no real email sent, ADR-3).
- [ ] Given a supervisor field referencing another employee, when registration completes, then the self-referencing supervisor hierarchy is stored correctly.
- [ ] Given a duplicate personal email, when HR Admin submits, then registration is rejected with a clear error.
- [ ] Given HR Admin edits an existing employee's payroll rate or supervisor, when saved, then the change is persisted and reflected in future leave/payroll calculations.

## Security AC (Stage 2 â€” Security Engineer)
- [ ] Given unauthenticated request, when hitting employee create/edit endpoints, then rejected 401 â€” HR Admin only, enforced server-side not just UI.
- [ ] Given non-HR-Admin authenticated user, when attempting employee create/edit, then rejected 403 (RBAC, prevents privilege-escalation via direct API call).
- [ ] Given payroll rate/supervisor payload, when submitted, then server-side validated (type/range) â€” not trusted from client.
- [ ] Given a registration error, when returned to caller, then no PII or internal detail leaked in error body.
- [ ] Given generated password, when issued, then meets minimum complexity; delivery is mocked via a one-time HR Admin-facing dialog for v0.1.0 (ADR-3) â€” accepted trade-off: HR Admin transiently sees the employee's plaintext password, password is never logged or persisted client-side beyond the dialog.
- [ ] Given employee record created/edited, when action completes, then audit log entry recorded (actor, timestamp, diff) â€” repudiation control.

**Compliance (PDPA Malaysia â€” Must Ship, non-negotiable):**
- [ ] Given employee PII (name, personal email, payroll rate) at rest, when stored, then field/DB-level encryption applied.
- [ ] Given employee PII, when accessed, then access restricted to HR Admin (and the employee's own record) â€” no broad read access.

Sign-off: `security: conditional` â€” cleared provided PDPA baseline (encryption at rest + access restriction + audit log) ships in v1; deeper PDPA workflows (data subject requests, retention automation) explicitly deferred, flagged for Stage 7 escalation since Edward scoped "no extra regulatory controls" but compliance override makes PDPA baseline non-negotiable.

## Test Strategy (QA)
Types: unit (validation, duplicate-email check), component integration (DB + Authentik provisioning call), e2e (register â†’ credential dialog â†’ login round-trip with #KAN-3). Greenfield â€” no regression-impact-matrix needed.

## Accessibility AC (Stage 4 â€” UI/UX, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Given the registration/edit form, when navigated via keyboard only, then every field and the submit button are reachable in a logical tab order with visible focus indicators.
- [ ] Given a field validation error, when it appears, then it is programmatically associated to its input via `aria-describedby` (not color/icon alone).
- [ ] Given the employee list table, when read by a screen reader, then column headers are announced with each cell (`scope`/`th` semantics).

## Dependencies
None â€” foundation story.

## Notes
Employee entity is the base for leave and payroll. Supervisor is a nullable self-referencing FK (HR Admin has no supervisor). HR Admin is a fixed super-admin role, not a separate registerable entity.

cards.title: [Story] Authentik Login for Employees
cards.body:
## User Story
As an Employee (including Supervisor and HR Admin), I want to log in with my email and generated password via Authentik, so that I can access the portal appropriate to my role.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given valid Authentik-provisioned credentials, when a user logs in, then a session is established and a role-appropriate portal view is shown (HR Admin / Supervisor / Employee).
- [ ] Given invalid credentials, when login is attempted, then access is denied with a clear error.

## Security AC (Stage 2 â€” Security Engineer)
- [ ] Given repeated failed login attempts, when threshold exceeded, then Authentik lockout/rate-limit applies (confirm native policy enabled, not custom-built).
- [ ] Given a valid session, when a token is issued, then it's scoped to the user's role and carries a standard expiry (no indefinite sessions).
- [ ] Given a login failure, when an error is returned, then the message is generic (no user-enumeration distinguishing "unknown email" from "wrong password").

Compliance: NIST 800-63 authentication baseline â€” satisfied by existing `AuthentikPlugin`/OIDC integration, no new control needed.

Sign-off: `security: cleared` â€” relies on already-hardened Authentik integration.

## Test Strategy (QA)
Types: component integration (auth flow against Authentik), e2e (login â†’ role-based view). Greenfield.

## Accessibility AC (Stage 4 â€” UI/UX, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Given the Authentik-hosted login form, when navigated via keyboard, then email/password fields and submit are reachable in order with visible focus (Authentik default theme â€” verify it meets AA, else customise).
- [ ] Given a login error, when shown, then it is announced to screen readers (live region), not only visually displayed.

## Dependencies
- Depends on: #KAN-2 â€” employee record + Authentik account must exist first.

## Notes
Authentik OIDC per repo architecture axiom. Password change/reset flow out of scope unless flagged later.

cards.title: [Story] Leave Request, Approval & Balance Tracking
cards.body:
## User Story
As an Employee, I want to submit a leave request (annual/sick/unpaid) so that my supervisor can review it; as a Supervisor, I want my own leave reviewed by HR Admin instead of my own supervisor.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given an employee submits a leave request with type + dates, when their supervisor reviews it, then the supervisor can approve or reject.
- [ ] Given a supervisor submits their own leave request, when HR Admin reviews it, then HR Admin can approve or reject.
- [ ] Given an employee has a fixed annual/sick leave entitlement, when a request is submitted, then the remaining balance is checked and displayed.
- [ ] Given approved leave exceeds the employee's remaining annual/sick balance, when calculated, then the excess days are recorded as unpaid leave.

## Security AC (Stage 2 â€” Security Engineer)
- [ ] Given an employee, when attempting to approve/reject their own leave request, then rejected 403 (self-approval blocked).
- [ ] Given a supervisor, when attempting to approve/reject leave for someone not their direct report, then rejected 403 (authorization scoped to actual hierarchy, checked server-side).
- [ ] Given a supervisor's own leave request, when submitted, then it is routed only to HR Admin (never to the supervisor's own supervisor or self).
- [ ] Given a leave request payload, when submitted, then balance/date values are validated server-side (reject negative days, backdated abuse) â€” not trusted from client.

Compliance: leave data shares the employee PII store â€” same PDPA baseline as #KAN-2 (encryption at rest, access restriction, audit log on approve/reject).

Sign-off: `security: conditional` â€” cleared provided authorization checks are server-side (not UI-only) and PDPA baseline from #KAN-2 covers this data too.

## Test Strategy (QA)
Types: unit (balance calc, unpaid conversion), component integration (approval routing incl. supervisorâ†’HR Admin branch), e2e (submit â†’ approve â†’ balance updated). Regression: none (greenfield), but touches #KAN-2's employee/supervisor data â€” verify hierarchy edits in #KAN-2 don't orphan in-flight leave requests.

## Accessibility AC (Stage 4 â€” UI/UX, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Given the leave request form's date pickers, when operated via keyboard, then dates are selectable without a mouse.
- [ ] Given the approval queue's Approve/Reject buttons, when reached via keyboard, then both are actionable and clearly labelled (not icon-only without accessible name).
- [ ] Given a request's status (pending/approved/rejected), when displayed, then status is conveyed by text/icon, not colour alone.

## Dependencies
- Depends on: #KAN-2 â€” employee + supervisor link required.
- Depends on: #KAN-3 â€” login/session required to submit or review.

## Notes
Leave types fixed for v1: annual, sick, unpaid. Unpaid-leave totals feed payroll deduction calculation (#KAN-5).

cards.title: [Story] Monthly Automated Payroll Generation
cards.body:
## User Story
As HR Admin, I want payroll auto-generated monthly per employee (monthly rate minus unpaid-leave deduction) as a PDF stored in MinIO, so that payroll records exist without manual calculation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given a month-end cron trigger, when the payroll job runs, then each employee's payroll = monthly rate âˆ’ (unpaid leave days that month Ã— daily rate).
- [ ] Given payroll is calculated for an employee, when generation completes, then a simple-format PDF is generated and saved to MinIO.
- [ ] Given payroll generation succeeds for an employee, when complete, then a notification event is emitted (see #KAN-6).

## Security AC (Stage 2 â€” Security Engineer)
- [ ] Given a payroll PDF in MinIO, when accessed, then access is restricted to HR Admin and the specific employee it belongs to (no public bucket, authz-checked retrieval â€” never a bare public URL).
- [ ] Given the payroll cron job, when it runs, then it uses least-privilege, Vault-issued service credentials (not a static superuser).
- [ ] Given the payroll job re-runs for a month already generated, when triggered, then it is idempotent (no duplicate PDF / double deduction).

Compliance: payroll = financial PII â†’ PDPA baseline (same as #KAN-2) plus MinIO server-side encryption at rest â€” Must Ship.

Sign-off: `security: conditional` â€” cleared provided PDF access is authz-checked (not a public/guessable MinIO URL) and SSE is enabled on the bucket.

## Test Strategy (QA)
Types: unit (payroll calc incl. unpaid deduction), component integration (cron trigger â†’ PDF â†’ MinIO), e2e (month-end run â†’ employee notified). Regression: none (greenfield), but consumes #KAN-4's unpaid-leave data â€” verify late-approved leave doesn't silently skip that month's calc.

## Accessibility AC (Stage 4 â€” UI/UX, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Given the payslip list, when navigated via keyboard, then each row's download action is reachable and labelled with the specific month (not a generic "download" repeated with no context).

## Dependencies
- Depends on: #KAN-2 â€” employee payroll rate required.
- Depends on: #KAN-4 â€” unpaid leave days required for deduction calc.

## Notes
Cron-driven (CronDriver pattern, packages/server). New payroll server. PDF format kept simple, implementation discretion.

cards.title: [Story] In-App Notifications
cards.body:
## User Story
As any logged-in user, I want a notification icon showing relevant events, so that I stay informed without manually checking.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given an employee submits a leave request, when their supervisor next logs in (or is active), then the supervisor sees a "new leave request" notification.
- [ ] Given a leave request is approved or rejected, when the requesting employee next logs in (or is active), then they see a decision notification.
- [ ] Given monthly payroll is generated successfully, when the employee next logs in (or is active), then they see a "payroll generated" notification.

## Security AC (Stage 2 â€” Security Engineer)
- [ ] Given a user requests their notifications, when fetched, then only that user's own notifications are returned (no IDOR via sequential/guessable IDs).

Compliance: none beyond baseline â€” no new PII class introduced.

Sign-off: `security: cleared`.

## Test Strategy (QA)
Types: unit (notification fan-out on event), component integration (event â†’ notification record), frontend interaction (icon badge/read state). Greenfield.

## Accessibility AC (Stage 4 â€” UI/UX, WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Given the unread notification count changes, when updated, then it is announced via an ARIA live region, not visual-only.
- [ ] Given the notification bell, when reached via keyboard, then Enter/Space opens the dropdown and Escape closes it, with focus returned to the bell on close.

## Dependencies
- Depends on: #KAN-3 â€” requires session/login.
- Depends on: #KAN-4 â€” leave events source.
- Depends on: #KAN-5 â€” payroll events source.

## Notes
In-app only for v1 â€” no email/push. Icon shown across portal regardless of role.
